answer: Each agent identity requires a zero-knowledge attestation of a unique TPM/SGX enclave, binding its measurement to the thread state tree, walnut hash anchor, and lagoon consensus contract. Forging identities requires physically provisioning distinct silicon and defeating enclave attestation; the contract prices bonds on a quadratic curve O(N^2) and irreversibly slashes collateral for duplicate or invalid proofs, making mass Sybil creation economically prohibitive.
